title: Doula Business Suite – Excel & Google Sheets Templates
descriptionHtml:
Run a doula business or a small doula agency from 8 Excel workbooks: quotes, packages, payments, on-call cover, agency splits and cash. One payment of 29 dollars, no subscription, no macros.

You juggle due dates, pay contracted and backup doulas and cannot say which package pays per hour. Doula client-management software is usually billed every month, and agency plans often cost more per doula. This is 29 dollars once.

WHAT YOU CAN DO ✓ Check a new due date against on-call windows, your monthly cap and backup cover ✓ Find the package that earns least per hour and test a new price first ✓ Chase the right balance first and see cash held for work not yet done ✓ See cash 12 months ahead, test an owner draw and never miss a renewal date

WHAT IS INSIDE: 8 WORKBOOKS FOR ONE DOULA BUSINESS 1 Enquiries, Consultations and Quotes 2 Packages, Pricing and Profit per Hour 3 Contracts, Deposits and Payment Plans 4 On-Call Capacity and Backup Cover 5 Visits, Hours, Mileage and Births 6 Doulas, Agency Splits and Pay Runs 7 Referrals, Classes and Reviews 8 Money, Owner Pay and Renewals Each workbook has 20 tables, 18 tools, 12 forms, 12 documents, 12 checklists, 34 ready message texts, 30 dashboard numbers, 22 charts and 6 gauges. In all: 144 tools, 160 tables, 96 forms and 272 message texts on 632 ready pages. Each part is a blank workbook plus a copy filled with sample data.

WHO IT IS FOR Owner-doulas, solo doulas and small agencies with contracted and backup doulas. A solo doula uses the same sheets with one doula and no backup rota. NOT FOR: a client portal, online booking or e-signature. These are workbooks, not a web service or an app. They keep dates, hours, packages, payments and contact notes only, never health details. Not medical, legal or tax advice: ask the client's care provider, check your local rules, confirm tax with your adviser.

HOW IT WORKS 1 Open the workbook for the job. 2 Replace the sample rows with your own. 3 Read the dashboard and use the tools. Instructions are on the first sheet. Input cells are coloured; formula cells are locked (no password).

FILE FORMAT Standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice. Same engine as our other suites, which were tested in Google Sheets. No macros, no subscription. Dates follow your computer's regional format; change the currency symbol in one cell.

GUARANTEE If a file does not work as described, we fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days.

See the FAQ below.

What it does for you

  • Check a new due date against on-call windows, monthly cap and backup cover
  • Find the package that earns least per hour and test a new price before you change it
  • See who owes you first, with balances aged 0-30, 31-60 and 61+ days
  • See the cash held for work not yet done on every prepaid package
  • Spot on-call windows with no backup named before the window opens
  • Check every doula pay run against what was paid, and the margin on each client
  • Find the agency split that costs you money and the share that breaks even
  • Compare planned hours with real hours, miles and rest days for every client
  • Rank referral sources by income, not by count, and see who to thank
  • Answer the weekly questions with 144 ready tools that use your own numbers
  • See cash 12 months ahead and test an owner draw before you take it
  • Never miss a renewal date: red within 30 days, amber within 60

Do I need special software? Does it work in Google Sheets?
No. The files are standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice. They are built with the same engine as our other suites, which were tested in Google Sheets. There are no macros and no subscription.

I am a solo doula with no team. Is it for me?
Yes. Enter yourself as the only doula, leave the backup rota empty and skip the agency split tools. Enquiries, quotes, package profit per hour, deposits, on-call windows, hours, referrals and cash all work for one person.

Can an agency use it for several doulas, backup cover and agency splits?
Yes. It is built for an owner-doula who also takes clients, contracted doulas paid per client or per hour with an agency split, backup doulas on a shared on-call rota and a part-time admin. The sample data shows six contracted doulas and two backup doulas. There is no per-doula fee.

Can I use my own currency and date format?
Yes. Amounts are plain numbers and you change the currency symbol in one cell. Dates follow the regional format of your computer. Prices, caps, shares and targets are settings you choose yourself.

Does it replace doula client-management software?
Not entirely. It has no client portal, online booking or e-signature, and it keeps dates, hours, packages, payments and contact notes only, never health details. It gives you the reports owners need: income per hour, on-call capacity, backup cover, agency margin and cash. One payment of 29 dollars, no per-doula fee.

What if a file does not work as described?
We fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days of purchase.
